revisions.objective: Build a two-stage fused sum(abs(x)) with simple contiguous scalar loads and a conventional per-CTA reduction. Explore global work partitioning: vary first-stage partial count/granularity and the finalizer’s fan-in so the large input is sufficiently parallel while finalization stays cheap. Leave vectorized loads and thread/block mapping to T3. Every consumed partial must be written in the current call, and the finalizer must overwrite output. Validate all required sizes and the stated FP64 error bound; compare full-call time.
